column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Send” is rendered “Cast,” and “in the abundance of days” as “after many days.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Give” is rendered “Divide,” and “and also” as “or even.”
Close to the Hebrew; “There it will be” is rendered “there it lies.”
The Hebrew says “like bones in the womb of the pregnant”; NASB adds “how … are formed.” “Work” is rendered “activity.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Do not give rest to your hand” is rendered “do not be idle,” and “this or this” as “morning or evening sowing.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “Indeed” and “if.”
“Youth” is rendered “childhood,” and “walk in the ways of your heart and in the sight of your eyes” as “follow the impulses of your heart and the desires of your eyes.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Evil” is rendered “pain,” “flesh” as “body,” “black hair” as “the prime of life,” and “futility” as “fleeting.”
